thread:
Maya K.: Quick Q — I'm moving to Ireland on Apr 10 for ~4 months (partner's secondment). Questions: 1) Is WFH stipend paid while abroad and is it prorated? 2) Any shipping/household goods reimbursement we can use? 3) Do I need to change homebase/payroll for ~120 days? 4) Will benefits/healthcare continue? cc @Sophia (People Ops) @Ben - Payroll @Legal Bot

Sophia (People Ops): Thanks Maya — good questions. Please fill the Temporary Remote Location form so we have dates/address: <https://redwood.company/forms/intl-remote|intl remote form>. Quick answers: - WFH stipend: yes, generally continues but prorated to days in month and subject to payroll/homebase. - Shipping: one-time relocation reimbursement up to $1,500 with receipts + extra $500 small-ship allowance; must use approved vendors or pre-approve vendor. - Payroll/homebase: >90 days requires payroll/legal review. - Benefits: we try to keep benefits active but some local coverage limits apply. I'll kick this off.

Ben - Payroll: FYI — for ~120 days we need to run a Temporary Assignment review. Most folks stay on US payroll for assignments <180 days, but tax/social security exposures vary. Action items for Maya: 1) Submit the form. 2) Attach copy of lease/travel itinerary. 3) We'll generate a payroll advisory within 3-5 business days. Re WFH stipend proration: prorated by calendar days. Example: April stipend $200 -> if abroad Apr 10-30 you'll get 21/30 * $200 = $140. We'll confirm exact calc once form's in.

Legal Bot: Heads-up: Ireland has specific social insurance rules — if your partner's employer enrolls you as dependent that doesn't remove employer obligations. We need the exact travel dates and whether you'll do work for Redwood while physically in Ireland. If you might exceed 183 days, we'll need local tax registration. I'll review once Sophia files.

Julian R.: Thanks for flagging — team supportive. If there's any schedule changes let us know, we'll try to shift on-call windows.

Maya K.: Thanks all. Putting form in now. One more: is shipping reimbursement taxable? Also, any pre-approved moving vendors list?

Sophia (People Ops): Shipping reimbursement is typically taxable in US payroll unless landlord/temporary storage qualifies as business expense — we'll confirm with payroll. Pre-approved vendors list is here: <https://redwood.company/confluence/moving-vendors|moving vendors>, if you want a vendor outside list, ping me for pre-approval.

Ben - Payroll: Confirming: relocation reimbursements are taxable income in payroll unless handled as direct vendor payment. If you want non-taxable handling, we can pay vendor directly (requires vendor setup + invoice). Let us know vendor and amount.

Maya K.: Got it — I'll attach tentative vendor quote and the form. Appreciate the quick responses :raised_hands: 

Sophia (People Ops): Great — once we have form + vendor quote we'll reply with estimated proration and whether vendor payment is feasible. Expect initial advisory by end of next week.
